api.openapi_spec_url: UNVERIFIED (Square publishes an OpenAPI spec on GitHub; not fetched)

auth.token_lifetime: Access tokens 'expire after 30 days'; auth code expires after 5 minutes, single use
auth.refresh: Code flow refresh tokens are non-expiring until access revoked (PKCE flow: single-use, 90 days)

access_requirements.app_review_or_marketplace_listing: None mentioned for OAuth on the overview page (App Marketplace listing is optional)
access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Square account owner clicks our Connect with Square link, reviews the permission list and clicks Allow; we receive the code and exchange it server-side.

sandbox.how_to_get: Square Developer Console creates sandbox test accounts on app creation (self-serve)

incremental_sync: SearchOrders / ListPayments with updated_at or begin_time/end_time filters and cursor; plus webhooks for deltas
blockers: Per-merchant 30-day access token requires scheduled refresh job.
Rate limit figures not verified from primary source.
